description: On the operator Resources page: wake, sleep, resize, force backup, run restore check (one click, audit log). Data access (database console, env secrets, tinker, terminal) asks for a reason, opens a 30-minute per-app session, logs every query/command, shows the customer a notice in the app's activity. Update DPA wording on staff access. Phase 2 of r-5w7h5d0b902aeq0n.
title: Operator actions + guarded data-access sessions
